narrative.en: Somebody decided one pool was boring. It started in block 25828514 when the first V4 hook pair flickered to life — zero fee, tick spacing 200. Then another, a block later, tick spacing 25. Then the machine ran: fourteen pools in a row from 25828694 to 25828963. Not scattered whims. Watch the hook contracts. 0x2df78ebb650cdd2c0a50243f9d95784bfd6d2088 shows up in seven pools between 25828838 and 25828898, block after block, all with tick spacing 60 — like stamped on a conveyor. Two more carry 0x96b893683afbfec071e90f78d00de4bb932fe0cc, one early, one late, both tick spacing 200. In between, 0x2e4a2e0067f66404f17b7e1ffe3ddef9a528eaec at 25828908. The closer: another zero-fee pool at 25828963.
narrative.zh: 夜里有人嫌一个池子太冷清。25828514 高度上，第一对 V4 hook 池亮了——零费率，tickSpacing 200。隔一个块，又来一个，tickSpacing 25。然后从 25828694 到 25828963，十四个池子接连落地。这不是零散出手。看那 hook 地址：0x2df78ebb650cdd2c0a50243f9d95784bfd6d2088 在 25828838 到 25828898 之间连现七次，块块相随，tickSpacing 全是 60，仿佛流水线上冲压出来的。另有 0x96b893683afbfec071e90f78d00de4bb932fe0cc 两个池子，一个在序列前段，一个在后段，都是 tickSpacing 200。中间 25828908 插着 0x2e4a2e0067f66404f17b7e1ffe3ddef9a528eaec。收尾的又是一个零费率池，落在 25828963。

take.en: The pattern is too regular for noise: repeated hook addresses, uniform tick spacing, zero-fee bookends — someone is running an assembly line, not a lottery. When the router code gets fixed in the same night, the cards are being prepared for a game we haven't seen yet.
take.zh: 批量 hook、相同 tickSpacing、零费率首尾——这不是随手撒网，是按图纸排兵。代码库同夜修补，说明有人一边备粮一边画疆界，等的不是今晚，是下一场风。

narrative.en:
The cards were already on the felt before the day broke. Twelve V4 hook pools, laid out in a row, and almost every one of them plays against the empty address — the zero, which is to say ETH itself. One pool dares to pair WETH against a token called PIXEL, but that's the exception that proves the cut of the deck.

Watch the hooks. The same address, 0xb8d9477e...e0cc, turns up three times, same zero fee, same tick spacing of 200. No accident. Somebody is spreading one logic like a run of suit cards. Another hook, 0x7a3bc37f...4044, appears twice on the same token, 0x053369b5...5899, but with different fees — 3000 and 2500. Different spreads, different steps, same base. And that token itself moves two pools in sixteen blocks. First hand pleased them, so they bet again.

Fees tell the rest. Zero dominates — for the high-roll volume play where the spread isn't the profit. Ten thousand sits there, the house maximum, for the wild pairs. Three tables at 3000, the middle path. One odd 2500, a denomination you rarely see. The architecture says one thing: someone is building the house for outcome markets, not just liquidity.

Then the day closes with PR #443 from 0xprogrammable in programmable: 'Add release-dark Prediction V2 creation foundation.' Prediction V2. A dark release. The scaffolding for the whole construction. The quiet around these facts is louder than any noise. Somebody is assembling a deck. The only question is what game they'll deal first.
narrative.zh:
江湖风声起于微末。八月二十四日，链上冒出十二个V4 hook池，几乎全都对着零地址——也就是ETH本身。唯一一个拿WETH去对PIXEL的，像是孤例，却更印证了行规：多数人的手，都伸向同一副牌。

再看这些hook的来路。0xb8d9477e...e0cc三次现身，次次零费率、tickSpacing 200，分明是同一门派的暗器，一出手就是三枚。另一个0x7a3bc37f...4044，盯住同一个令牌0x053369b5...5899，却开出3000和2500两种费率，同一个靶子，试两种手法。那令牌本身也在十六个区块内连开两池——显然第一刀称手，第二刀紧随而至。

费率本身也有说法：零费率是给走量的人，不靠点差吃饭；10000是给烈性对子压阵；3000恰是江湖中最稳的中间路数；2500则是少见的偏门。这些配置不像随手而为，倒像在给不同赌局定规矩。

日暮时分，GitHub上PR #443由0xprogrammable提交到programmable，题为'Add release-dark Prediction V2 creation foundation'。Prediction V2，暗处落子，先打地基。到这一步，图景已隐约可见：链上的池子与链下的PR，原是同一场布局的不同机关。有人正在静默中攒一副大牌，问的只是——第一局，从哪张牌开始？

take.en: The on-chain hook pools and the off-chain PR are the same hand: prediction markets are being scaffolded in the dark, with fee tiers as the betting rules and a dark release as the frame.
take.zh: 今天的V4 hook池与那份PR#443，其实是同一局棋：有人正在暗处搭预测市场的骨架，不同费率就是不同赌局的规矩，而那份release-dark就是装下这一切的匣子。

narrative.en:
Four pools, one hook, same hand. The day didn't open with a single deployment—it opened with a production line. 0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc stamped itself across four V4 pools in near lockstep, zero fee, tick spacing 200, every pair married to WETH. Three of the tokens—0xd70e94, 0xe17462, 0xe41a29—have no history worth the ink, fresh contracts still warm. Then the deck splits. The fourth pool, 0xc656df, takes a 1% fee and swaps its hook to 0x523103. Not a mistake. A deliberate cut: one table for the sharks, the rest for the free ride.

Then the joker in the stack. Block 25813946 locks a token with the address prefix 0x000000000001. That isn't an accident. It's a planted marker, a token minted to mean nothing and everything. Fee zero, hook 0xbf8739. Someone is probing the edges—either simulating a mass farm or paving a quiet migration from V3. And one pool, 0xda9c47, breaks pattern: tick spacing 60, fee 0.3%, and a hook, 0x058b5ff03522, never seen before. Could be a dynamic-fee experiment, could be an order book in disguise.

All four initialized inside six blocks. No spontaneity. One hand dealt the entire table. The question isn't what these tokens are. The question is the next move—when these quiet pools suddenly drink their first real liquidity.
narrative.zh:
这一日不是落子，而是铸印。同一枚 hook——0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc——四座 V4 池几乎同时开张，零费率，tick 间距 200，家家都傍着 WETH。三枚代币 0xd70e94、0xe17462、0xe41a29 皆是无根无史的新脸孔，像是刚从模具里脱出。第四池 0xc656df 却独取百分之一费率，换了一枚 hook 0x523103。这不是失手，是分席：一桌留给猛客，其余供人白走一遭。

最诡异的还是区块 25813946 上那一池。代币地址以 0x000000000001 开头——那不是随缘而生的地址，是刻意压低的印记。零费率，hook 0xbf8739。有人在试水，或试一场无声的迁徙，或演一场群生鼎沸的假象。还有 0xda9c47 那一池，tick spacing 60、费率千三，hook 0x058b5ff03522 前所未见。像是新创的费变阵，又像一本暗藏的 order book。

六块之内，四池齐立。没有散落，只有一手落子。真正的谜不是这些代币是什么，而是这手牌下一步往哪儿打——当这些静池迎来第一注真金，局面才真正翻涌。

take.en: The zero-fee V4 pools are not a play for today; they're a stacked deck waiting for the first real liquidity to be shuffled in.
take.zh: 零费率的多池并列，不是今日的战果，而是暗伏的阵法——只待第一道流动性入局，便见真章。

narrative.en: Sixteen new tables before sunrise—not poker. I watched the deal until my eyes burned; every block turned over another pool, like someone dealing cards in a dark room, faces hidden. More than half show the zero address on one side—always interesting, because that's how you enter with native coin. But the real cards are in the hooks.
narrative.zh: 一夜之间，江湖上多出十六张新桌子。我不是说赌坊——是流水深处新开的池子。我盯了一整夜，每出一个区块，就有一口新池被挖出来，像有人在黑灯瞎火里发牌，不露脸。多半数的池子，一侧是零地址。这路数不新鲜，走的是 native coin 进场的旧门道。但真正的后手，在 hook 里。

take.en: Sixteen pools in one night, one hook repeated three times, and a fee flag that isn't a typo—this isn't noise, it's a deck being shuffled for a game that hasn't been announced.
take.zh: 十六池一夜，同一 hook 三现，费率数字不是错笔——这不是杂音，是有人在未开盘前先把牌洗好了。

narrative.en:
Fourteen pools in a single night—and that's only what the scanner caught. The same hook contract keeps resurfacing: 0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc. Seven times in the latest blocks, each time paired with the zero address and a zero fee. Tick spacing 200—the standard spread for wide ranges. This is not a series of spontaneous launches. This is a conveyor belt being fed.

Then the deck turned to rarer notes. A pool with fee 8388608 (0.8%) and tick spacing 60—not for crowd trading, but for low-volatility instruments. Its hook matches one of the tokens: a classic case where the token itself sits in the hook slot. Right behind it came the standard 0.3% trio with ticks 30, though this one carried a different hook: 0x85e24ffa15ac649c3323c8bec7910ba67caec0cc. And so it went—each block dealt a new pool, each with its own handwriting.

Separately, I caught a USDC/WETH pool with the same nonstandard fee of 8388608 and tick spacing 60, but with another hook: 0x7f35e2e51a3359f8e793527faaaef6dc745cc0c4. That is not a random pair; that is liquidity laid out for professional strategies. Then another USDC pool, this time paired with token 0x33ce4375f93fa3c348ee1ad0ab8fe33f534d0088, fee 1%—and once again the token itself acts as the hook. You can see different teams, different protocols, spinning up their V4 infrastructures in parallel, not crossing paths.

The night was dense. The deck shuffles fast, and every new pool is another card placed on the felt. Some are building a combination; some are simply shedding cards. But when a line of pools with the same hook and zero fee shows up inside a few hours, this is not blind play. It is calculation.
narrative.zh:
一夜之间，扫描到的池子就有十四个，而且这还只是扫进网里的。同一个钩子合约反复冒头：0xb8d9477eb6ef5f0df5219cf0c8130dd7e520e0cc。最近几个区块里出现了七次，每次都是零地址配对、手续费为零。Tick间距200，宽幅振荡的标准布法。有人不是在下散注，是在铺一条流水线——同一套图纸，同一副骨架，一个一个立起来。

也有更稀罕的变数。一个池子手续费8388608（0.8%）、tick间距60，这不是给散户热闹用的，是给低波动工具备的。它的钩子和某个代币地址相同，属于典型的代币自身充当钩子。紧跟着又有一个标准0.3%池，tick间距30，但钩子换成了0x85e24ffa15ac649c3323c8bec7910ba67caec0cc。一个区块接一个区块，新池不断翻出，各有各的笔迹。

另外看到一个USDC/WETH池，同样是那组非常规手续费8388608和tick间距60，钩子却又是另一个：0x7f35e2e51a3359f8e793527faaaef6dc745cc0c4。这不是随手一配，是给职业策略备的粮。还有一个USDC池，配的代币是0x33ce4375f93fa3c348ee1ad0ab8fe33f534d0088，手续费1%，钩子又是代币自己。看得出来，几路人马各自在V4的江湖里开宗立派，平行铺开，互不搭界。

夜色很浓。筹码翻得极快，每一个新池都是一张落桌的牌。有人在做牌局，有人在甩闲牌。但像这样，同一个钩子、零手续费，几个小时内接连立起一排池子——这不是闭眼押注，是早就排好的阵。

take.en: Someone is not gambling—they are building a deployment machine. The repeated zero-fee hook and cloned parameters are the tell: a deliberate pipeline, not a random hand.
take.zh: 这不是赌运气，是有人在排兵布阵。重复的零费钩子和一模一样的参数，说明背后是流水线一样的部署手艺。

narrative.en:
Deal a hand from this deck and you'll find a hook pool with no cut and a two-hundred notch ladder, a dozen of them, WETH on every end. That alone wouldn't raise a brow on V4. But one hook contract appears three times, another four times — no gambler mistakes that for chance. Someone is dealing the deck methodically.

The first pool opened against a WETH-facing token with a thirty-basis-point cut and a sixty-step ladder. Thirty-five blocks later, another appeared, with a tighter cut of 3.75 basis points and a four-step ladder, a different hook. Then the wave came: five pools in forty blocks, all different tokens, same WETH spine, zero cut, wide spread — someone testing how fine a market can be sliced at two-hundred notch granularity.

Then the wild card: a pool without WETH — eETH opposite an unknown token, zero cut, sixty-step ladder, a hook never seen at the table. And the closer: a pool against USDC, with a 0.075% cut and the tightest ladder of the deal, a one-step spread. That wasn't a test; that was a seat taken. What we saw is three waves: first, scouts with mixed cuts; second, a zero-cut cluster minted by the same hooks, liquidity stamped to one strategy; third, a march past WETH dominance into stablecoin territory. One pool carries a cut of 8,388,608 — not a cut, a flag. It's either a corrupt card or a deliberate marker. The deck isn't complete, but the pattern is already readable.
narrative.zh:
江湖上有人发牌。随手抽一张，便是不收过路费的钩子池，价差细到两百格，一端全是WETH。一打这样的池子浮出水面，原也不算稀奇。可同一个钩子合约出现三次，另一个出现四次——老江湖看了，只问一句：这不是巧合，是谁在按套路落子。

第一池开局是WETH对一枚陌生令牌，千分之三的过路费，六十步的间距。过了三十五步，又来一池，费率降到万分之三点七五，间距缩到四步，钩子换了人。接着是一阵密集响动：四十步内连开五池，令牌各不同，骨架全是WETH，不收过路费，间距放宽。这是有人在试水，看这二百格的窄道能不能走通。

然后来了张百搭牌：一池没有WETH。eETH对一枚无名的令牌，不收过路费，六十步间距，钩子是个新面孔。末了，一池对USDC，费率百分之零点零七五，间距一步——整场最窄的路。这不是试水，是拍桌子坐下。回头看，三波手笔。第一波，各色费率，是探路；第二波，零费率成串，同一套钩子反复出现，像是按同一门心法灌注内力；第三波，走出WETH的圈子，接了稳定币。其间有一池挂着八百三十八万八千六百零八的费率——那不像费率，像旗号。要么是错牌，要么是有意为之。牌没发完，但牌路已经亮了。

take.en: The repeated hook contracts are not chance; someone is dealing from a marked deck, and the final USDC entry is a seat taken at the real table.
take.zh: 重复出现的钩子不是巧合，是有人握着一副做过记号的牌；最后那张USDC落座，说明赌局已经摆到台面上了。

narrative.en: The deal came in overnight with over a dozen new V4 pools, nearly every one of them running on zero commission. Not a stray chip or a pair of accidents—a methodical run, as if a player is working through combinations by feel. Three pools in a row, same hook, zero commission, same fine pitch. Then another with the same hook. Then two more with a different hook, still zero, but a wider step. You don't see randomness; you see a pattern being planted.
narrative.zh: 一夜之间，江湖上浮出十多个 V4 池子，几乎全部不收手续费。这不像零星试探，更像有人按着拳谱在拆招。三个池子连着来，同一只钩，零费率，步数一致；接着又来一个同钩子的；再有两个换了钩子，依然是零费率，只是步子放宽。深夜无人时，这种整齐的出手最让人清醒。

take.en: Zero-commission pools are not a glitch—they are a map. Someone is deliberately dealing WETH pairs with surgical hooks, marking territory before the real game begins.
take.zh: 零费率的池子不是杂音，是有人画地界。拿 WETH 配钩子、试步数，就是在为真正的交锋提前落子。

narrative.en: ...and so sixteen new pools in a single deal, plus or minus sixty transactions. Not deploys, not dry runs—initializations with live hooks. Every hook contract is unique, the addresses ending in 888. That is no coincidence; that is a pattern. I read the layout: USDT is being married to an unknown token through a hook pool at a commission of 100—the narrowest of spreads, micro-steps, a board built for delicate play. Then the repeats: the same token 0x07fff99... appears twice, switching partners, first 0xcf62f9..., then 0xcacd6f.... The vig is 200 everywhere. This is not a random scatter. Someone is stacking liquidity on one base with different house rules for every table. And that one pair with 0x22222222aea0076fca927a3f44dc0b4fdf9479d6—if it is what it smells like, a 2500-basis-point stake on a volatile instrument where the hooks are not just managing orders but insuring positions. Or maybe just harvesting the rake. Each hook address is its own logic. 0xc29989e..., 0xc2ba52ef..., 0xc27b8c85...—no template copies. Someone paid gas, paid deployment, paid configuration. Sixteen configurations in one round. The question is not whether this is a test; the question is who spends resources to build parallel liquidity layers with different conditions on the same tokens. And note the timestamp—all inside a single heartbeat. This is not activity stretched across time; it is a volley. Someone is preparing the infrastructure for something specific. Or someone specific. The cards are on the felt. We watch who calls.
narrative.zh: 江湖上传来消息：一息之间，十六个新池子同时立起，加上大约六十笔交易。不是空壳部署，不是试水——是带着活钩子的开山立派。每个钩子合约都独一无二，地址都以888结尾，这不是巧合，这是门派的路数。我细看布局：USDT与一个来历不明的币种结盟，钩子池的费率是100——价差窄到极致，步距细到一微步，分明是精巧的内力操盘。再看，同一个币0x07fff99...两次现身，先配0xcf62f9...，再配0xcacd6f...，费率都是200。这不是随手撒网，是有人以同一根基蓄养流动性，却给每张桌子定下不同的规矩。最扎眼的是那个0x22222222aea0076fca927a3f44dc0b4fdf9479d6——若是我所想的那物，2500个基点的筹码压在一个大起大落的兵器上，钩子怕不只是管单子，还要护住仓位，或者干脆收过路费。每个钩子地址都是独立心法。0xc29989e...、0xc2ba52ef...、0xc27b8c85...——没有一张是复制的。有人付了gas，付了部署，付了配置。一轮十六套配置。问题不在这是不是试探，而在谁在花费资源，在同一个币种之上，铺开不同规则的平行流动性层。再看时间——全在一念之间。这不是拖泥带水的动作，是一记齐射。有人在为某件大事备下阵势。或者为某个人。牌已亮，风已起，且看谁先落子。

take.en: Sixteen hook-loaded pools fired in one beat means someone is laying out a full liquidity board on purpose—this is infrastructure, not noise. The 888-ending hooks are a signature, and repeated tokens with shifting partners say the game is already rigged—by the house, not for us.
take.zh: 十六个带钩子的池子同时落位，这不是试探，是有人在一张棋盘上排兵布阵。同一个币反复配对，钩子地址皆为888——江湖上不怕对手凶狠，就怕有人连退路都已布好。

narrative.en:
Sixteen fresh pools hit the felt overnight, and a gambler reads the stack for the tell. Four of them lay down with zero rake — 0xdc43…f091, 0x693f…4eac, 0x5edc…9492, 0x66c9…fb53 — and their spacing is marked at 200 and 25, like someone tracing ranges on an empty table. But the real tell is the hook contracts: 0x6893…0cc appears twice, 0x96b8…0cc appears twice. Same code, different chips. That isn't accident; that's a system running its hands in silence.

Seven of the new hands are priced at one percent, each with WETH on one side — the zero address means ether. Three sit at three-tenths of a percent. One is nearly free, 0.0001%, token 0xee45…6a38, hook 0x432f…c0c — someone who wants to trade without giving up a sliver. And deeper down, some hooks are already setting the swap fee in real time, changing the cut at the table's discretion instead of locking a fixed sticker. That is hooks acting as economic levers, not ornaments.

GitHub is quiet but not idle: hazarxyz pushed a fix to keep mobile token-copy controls visible in the V4 interface. Small polish, yet it shows a hand working the UI for these contraptions. Sixteen pools in one night is not a sprint; it's a marathon deal being dealt before the crowd turns around. I keep my eyes on the hooks.
narrative.zh:
后半夜的江湖，有人往桌上甩了十六块新牌——Uniswap 的 V4 又长出新池子。四块牌子不收过路费：0xdc43…f091、0x693f…4eac、0x5edc…9492、0x66c9…fb53，间距刻着 200 和 25，像是在空地上画好格子再慢慢练拳。真正扎眼的是钩子重复了：0x6893…0cc 出现两回，0x96b8…0cc 也出现两回。同一个心法，挂在不同门派下，这不是随手为之，是有人按谱落子。

七口池子收一个点的过路费，另一头全挂的是 WETH；三口收千分之三；还有一口只收万分之一，代币是 0xee45…6a38，钩子是 0x432f…c0c。有人想近身肉搏，连滑点都不想给。更亮的是有些钩子直接在交易时定费用——过路费由阵法的内功当场决定，不是刻死的价签。这是把钩子当经济命门来用，不是挂个招牌充门面。

GitHub 那边也不是静水：hazarxyz 改了 programmable，让手机端复制代币地址的按钮一直看得见。界面功夫不多，却说明有人在专门打磨这些 V4 物件的门面。一夜十六口池子，不是短跑，是有人把内力往长局里铺。

take.en: The repeated hooks and the spread of rakes say these are no air checks; someone is building an economic lattice across V4 before the crowd notices.
take.zh: 十六口池子，同一路心法重复出现；这不是试水，是有人要在 V4 的版图上占个座。

narrative.en: The table's been busy while you were counting chips. Five new hook pools hit the felt in a single day, and four of them show token A as the zero address — pure ETH, no wrappers, no disguises. This is not chance; this is a pattern. Three pools share the same hook contract, two of them with the same pairing of zero address and some junk token. Someone is testing the mechanics, maybe dynamic fees or stretched orders in the style of TWAMM. The fee is zero, the ticks are wide, the liquidity is thin — this is not a game for the retail crowd.
narrative.zh: 今日江湖水浑。五个新的 V4 hook 池子同日现身，其中四个，A 币都是零地址——纯正的 ETH，没有一丝包装。这不是巧合，这是刀法。三个池子同出一个 hook 契约，两个更是同一对：零地址配一个垃圾币。有人在试招，或是动态手续费，或是类似 TWAMM 的慢刀子。手续费为零，tick 间距宽，池子浅，不是给散户的局。

take.en: A single hook is laying down a telltale pattern of pools, and the registry fix suggests the house wants to trace every hand back to its dealer.
take.zh: 一个 hook 契约连番按下池子，江湖上多的是浅水；注册表一改，执棋者要看清每一手棋从何而来。

narrative.en: The night dealt nine fresh pools on the Uniswap V4 felt before anyone could count them, and every hand carried the same tell: a hook contract sewn straight into the token address. That is not luck, that is a factory fingerprint. Most of these hands run against zero, against ETH directly, with zero commission and a two-hundred step spacing — the signature of one master, with twin contracts stamping pools like a conveyor belt. Other hands paid real price for entry: ten-thousand commission, USDC on the other side, wider spacing — that trade already smells like a market, not a test.
narrative.zh: 今夜Uniswap V4这个江湖出牌极快，短短几百个区块之间，九个新池子齐刷刷落地，几乎每一手都带着同一个纹路：钩子契约直接嵌进代币地址里。这不是巧合，是某个厂牌的印记。多数池子对着零、对着ETH直接出手，零佣金、两百步的间隔——像同一个师傅的笔法，两个孪生契约像流水线一样盖池子。另几手则交了真金白银的入门费：万级佣金，USDC对面，间距放宽，这交易已经有市井烟火气，不是练功场。

take.en: One tool, one signature, nine pools in one night — the house isn't shuffling, it's mass-producing the deck.
take.zh: 一个工具，一个掌印，一夜九个池子——这不是洗牌，这是有人在大批量做牌。

narrative.en: Twelve pools laid on the felt overnight, and eleven of them showing zero ether on one side of the pair — someone is methodically dealing the same card again and again. The hooks repeat: 0x0d62529346, then again, then once more. 0x96b893683afbfec also appears twice. This is no accident and no chaos — it is a hand dealt from the same sleeve, only with different token faces instead of players. The table is wide, tickSpacing 200 almost everywhere — broad strides, a player not aiming at precision but at range. Only one pool breaks the pattern: fee 3000, tickSpacing 30, block 25734805 — someone decided to play a tight hand, a dense grid. And out of twelve, exactly one pool holds non-zero token on both sides — block 25735726, hooks 0xbbdf135f842 — the joker among empty suits. While this unrolled on one table, another game went quiet and coded. 0xprogrammable closed three PRs in a row: valuation parity, batch price recovery, proof inventory. Words from a casino ledger — aligning stakes, recovering price after a fault, inventorying evidence. Three fixes overnight, one after another, as if someone is patching leaks in the accounting system before the morning shift opens the tables. And separately, v4-periphery PR #588 — SafeCast for swap delta in the quoter. A small but telling correction: without it, numbers could truncate where they should not, and the quote would lie quietly, without a scream. The night was not about loud bets. It was about the infrastructure under the table — hooks repeating like marked cards, and code repairing what cannot be seen beneath the green felt while no one is watching.
narrative.zh: 一夜之间，江湖上多了十二个池子。十一个池子，一侧空空如也，以太不沾边。有人不急不慢，把同一张牌翻来覆去地出——钩子重复出现，0x0d62529346 来了又走，走了又来，0x96b893683afbfec 也现身两回。这不是乱局，这是同一个掌法换了不同的面具，十二个名字，一种内功。大多数池子步幅极宽，tickSpacing 二百，大开大合，不求精细，只求圈住风水。只有一个池子例外，fee 三千，tickSpacing 三十，区块 25734805——那是有人下了盘细棋，针脚密得很。十二池之中，只有一处两边都有真金白银：区块 25735726，钩子 0xbbdf135f842。万花丛中一点绿，满桌空牌里唯一的孤注。与此同时，另一张桌子上演着无声的功夫。0xprogrammable 连收三剑：估值对齐、批量价格恢复、凭证清点。听起来像是当铺先生深夜拨算盘——把赌注摆平，把断掉的价格接上，把证据一件件归档。三处修补，依次落下，像给账本打上补丁，趁天亮开张之前。还有一桩小事，v4-periphery 的 PR #588，给报价格子里的 swap 增量加了一道 SafeCast。改动不起眼，却让人心里一紧：没有它，数字会在不该断的地方断掉，报价便会在无声中失真。这一夜，没有惊天动地的豪赌。功夫都在台面之下，重复的钩子像江湖上流传的暗号，改动的代码像夜里补好的旧账。等众人醒来时，桌子已经擦净，牌已经码齐。

take.en: The house is not playing for entertainment; it is dealing the same hook from a marked deck while the ledger underneath is being stitched closed before the next hand settles.
take.zh: 江湖夜雨，十二个池子十一个空，唯有一处两面俱全；真正的功夫不在水面，而在钩子与账本的暗处。

narrative.en: The only table with real teeth was WETH against some f8d30a... card, where the house took a dynamic cut — 8388608, a number that doesn't match the usual scale, so the hook decides per hand what it skins. One such pool against thirteen empty shells: a rare card in a deck full of jokers. And in another room, while blocks stamped out pools, someone quietly opened a pull-request: freeze typed adoption grant preflight. One hand deals liquidity to every comer, the other locks the door and checks who deserves a seat.
narrative.zh: 唯一一张不像空壳的桌子，是 WETH 对某个 f8d30a... 的筹码，抽水用的是八百万级别的动态数——这不是寻常刻度，而是那只看手自己决定每一把的价钱。十三张空台子里夹着这么一张，算是摸到一张稀罕牌。而另一头，正当区块忙着印台子的时候，有人悄悄递了一纸文书：冻结那笔“类型化收养资助预检”。一边在大把派发内力，另一边却开始关门验客，看看谁有资格坐上桌来。

take.en: The house is testing the machinery, not the cards: one hook contract grinding out pools is the tell, and the freeze-preflight pull request is the quiet cover bet.
take.zh: 这一夜的真话不在新台子的多少，而在同一个门派用同一只手连开数台——真正的试探是对机制的试探；而那道冻结预检的文书，是暗处里的另一手棋。

narrative.en:
The night dealt thirteen fresh tables on V4, and every one of them opened with the house taking nothing. Zero fee is not generosity—it is the quiet before the deal, when the vig moves from the trader to the hook itself. The developers know how to palm a deck: a contract-hook replacing the standard fee mechanism is a joker that rewrites the rule of the game.

I noticed the pattern: ffff addresses repeat like one player sitting down at different masks—0xffffef45, 0xffff1b3b, 0xffffe511. Pairs with native ether and with WBTC are classic high cards, yet the spacing between ticks jumps from 60 to 200, as if the dealer cannot decide how tight to pull the range. One hook—0x0d6252...—showed up twice, on different pairs. Either this is a pool factory, or somebody loves their own code enough to stake it again and again.

While tables were opening on-chain, the programmable project was quietly changing clothes on GitHub. Three pull requests overnight: two documentation redesigns in a row—first broad, then narrow, repo-specific—and a fix for validating sensitive environment variables. README was updated right after the third merge, commit 5661c41 closed the hand. The order says it all: first patch the hole in secret validation, then polish the shop window. That is the standard sequence for someone preparing to show the project to a new audience—an investor, an auditor, the world.

None of this shouts. Thirteen pools with zero fee and a tidied-up documentation shelf are not fireworks; they are the table being set before big players sit down. The night is quiet, but the cards are already laid.
narrative.zh:
一夜之间，V4江湖开了十三张新桌，几乎每张桌上都写着“不收份子钱”。费率为零不是豪爽，是悄悄换了个收法——真正的进账不来自过路客，而来自那枚藏在桌底的钩子。做局的人懂怎么把牌藏在袖口：用一个合约钩子替掉常规的收费规矩，等于把游戏规则整个翻新了一遍。

我看出点名堂：ffff开头的地址反复出现，像是同一个玩家换了面具坐到不同桌上——0xffffef45、0xffff1b3b、0xffffe511。配的是原生以太和WBTC，都是经典的压箱底筹码，可区间间隔从60跳到200，仿佛庄家自己都没定夺该把网撒多紧。有一枚钩子，0x0d6252...，在两张不同的桌上亮了相。要么这是家专门开池的作坊，要么就是有人太爱自己的手艺，翻来覆去地使。

链上摆桌的同时，GitHub上那个programmable门派也悄悄换了行头。一夜三个改动：两次文档改版——先是全局，后是门派专属；一次修补密钥环境变量的校验。第三次合并之后立刻更新了README，commit 5661c41收尾。顺序说明一切：先堵住漏气的地方，再擦亮招牌。这是准备给新人看货的标准动作——投资人、审计师、或是整个江湖。

这些都不张扬。十三个零费池子加一排干净的文档，不是烟火，是摆好桌子等大客入座。夜很静，但牌已经铺开了。

take.en: The house is not giving anything away—it is changing the rules of the vig, and the real fee will be collected from the hook, not the player.
take.zh: 江湖没有白送的茶钱——不过是从台前改到了台后，真正要收的，还是从钩子里掏。
